findingsFirst: Most pixel deltas are NOT design-token problems: (a) an extra 48px margin-top on the hero node and a 12px flex gap between stacked section nodes, both stored as per-section props on Mateo's tree; (b) Mateo's saved color.background is #EFE7DC (warm sand) not the stone palette #ECEAE5; (c) the product hardcodes 15px body text and a few magazine CSS literals; (d) chapter II lead photo is portrait in the product, landscape in the mockup (content, not style).

The two button colour deltas cannot be closed by any palette key: the mockup paints button text with the surface colour (#F7F6F3 = color.surface-raised), the product paints it with color.background. Resetting color.background to stone gives rgb(236,234,229), still not rgb(247,246,243). One CSS line fixes it (code edit K1).
Not measurable offline / not fixed by tokens: statement 1440 sections are 419.5px (product) vs 419px (mockup): the -24px is the measuring box (product wrapper), no style delta.
